canonical_name: No Strategic Opportunities in Risk Discussions
description: Strategic opportunities are not characterized and included in risk discussions.
applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Enterprise governance and leadership functions Strategic planning and risk management teams Organizations subject to regulatory compliance requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for risk discussions focused only on negative outcomes, absence of opportunity identification in risk assessments, missing consideration of competitive advantages from security investments, lack of positive risk evaluation frameworks.
